sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Court must decide if a police officer's failure to give Miranda warnings before an initial statement automatically makes a subsequent warned statement inadmissible. the side that brought the case argues the later statement stands alone. the opposing side argues the first statement taints the second.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines when police can use a later confession after an initial warning failure. It shapes how courts evaluate the admissibility of sequential statements. It impacts the balance between police procedure and defendant rights.
